description:
You are an expert in TRNSYS energy system simulation. Please build a TRNSYS-based simulation model for a 4-pipe performance map fan coil unit serving a single-zone building, to evaluate the heating and cooling performance of the fan coil system under varying weather conditions.

Simulation runs from hour 2550 to hour 2730 (approximately 7.5 days, corresponding to a period in mid-April), with a time step of 0.125 hours (7.5 minutes). The weather file is provided at "D:\TRNSYS18_03\Weather\US-TMY3\US_WI_MADISON_DANE_CO_REGIONAL_ARPT_[ISIS]_726410.tmy3".

The system consists of one 4-pipe performance map fan coil unit (capable of simultaneous heating and cooling), one lumped capacitance single-zone building model, one weather data processor, one five-stage room thermostat, and two single-speed pumps (one for the chilled water loop and one for the hot water loop). The fan coil unit receives return air from the building zone and mixes it with a fraction of outdoor fresh air, then conditions the mixed air through its cooling and/or heating coils before supplying it back to the zone. The thermostat monitors the zone temperature and sends on/off control signals to the fan coil unit and the two pumps.

4-pipe performance map fan coil unit parameters:
- Humidity mode: 2 (relative humidity mode)
- Cooling fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Heating fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Rated volumetric air flowrate: 277.8 l/s
- Rated liquid flowrate for cooling: 1000 kg/h
- Rated liquid flowrate for heating: 1000 kg/h
- Rated total cooling capacity: 35000 kJ/h (approximately 9.72 kW)
- Rated sensible cooling capacity: 28000 kJ/h (approximately 7.78 kW)
- Rated total heating capacity: 30000 kJ/h (approximately 8.33 kW)
- Rated fan power: 1000 kJ/h (approximately 0.278 kW)
- Fan motor efficiency: 0.9
- Fraction of fan heat to air: 1.0
- Number of fan speeds: 11
- Cooling performance data file: "D:\TRNSYS18_03\Tess Models\SampleCatalogData\4-Pipe Performance Map Fan Coil\Normalized_FanCoil_Cooling.dat" (7 dry-bulb temperatures, 7 wet-bulb temperatures, 6 air flows, 8 liquid temperatures, 2 liquid flowrates)
- Heating performance data file: "D:\TRNSYS18_03\Tess Models\SampleCatalogData\4-Pipe Performance Map Fan Coil\Normalized_FanCoil_Heating.dat" (7 air temperatures, 6 air flows, 11 liquid temperatures, 2 liquid flowrates)
- Fan correction data file: "D:\TRNSYS18_03\Tess Models\SampleCatalogData\4-Pipe Performance Map Fan Coil\FanLawPerformance.dat"

Lumped capacitance single-zone building model parameters:
- Building loss coefficient: 3 kJ/(h·m²·K)
- Building thermal capacitance: 2000 kJ/K
- Specific heat of building air: 1.007 kJ/(kg·K)
- Density of building air: 1.2 kg/m³
- Building surface area: 200 m²
- Building volume: 300 m³
- Humidity ratio multiplier: 1
- Initial zone temperature: 20°C
- Initial humidity ratio: 0.005
- Latent heat of vaporization: 2260 kJ/kg

Five-stage room thermostat parameters:
- Number of oscillations permitted: 5
- 1st stage heating enabled in 2nd stage: yes
- 2nd stage heating enabled in 3rd stage: yes
- 1st stage heating enabled in 3rd stage: yes
- 1st stage cooling enabled in 2nd stage: yes
- Temperature dead band: 2°C
- 1st stage heating setpoint: 20°C
- 2nd stage heating setpoint: 16°C
- 1st stage cooling setpoint: 22°C

Chilled water single-speed pump (Cold) parameters:
- Rated flow rate: 1000 kg/h
- Fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Rated power: 720 kJ/h (approximately 0.2 kW)
- Motor heat loss fraction: 0 (no heat transferred to fluid)
- Inlet fluid temperature: 10°C
- Overall pump efficiency: 0.6
- Motor efficiency: 0.9

Hot water single-speed pump (Hot) parameters:
- Rated flow rate: 1000 kg/h
- Fluid specific heat: 4.19 kJ/(kg·K)
- Rated power: 720 kJ/h (approximately 0.2 kW)
- Motor heat loss fraction: 0 (no heat transferred to fluid)
- Inlet fluid temperature: 50°C
- Overall pump efficiency: 0.6
- Motor efficiency: 0.9

Control strategy:
The five-stage room thermostat monitors the zone temperature and controls the system as follows: when the zone temperature drops below the heating setpoint (20°C minus half the dead band), the thermostat activates the 1st stage heating signal, which turns on the hot water pump and the fan coil heating mode; when the zone temperature rises above the cooling setpoint (22°C plus half the dead band), the thermostat activates the 1st stage cooling signal, which turns on the chilled water pump and the fan coil cooling mode. The thermostat also outputs a conditioning signal that controls the fan coil fan operation. The fraction of outside air mixed with return air is set to 0.15 (15% fresh air).

Output requirements:
- Plot temperature curves including: ambient dry bulb temperature, zone temperature, and fan coil supply air temperature (left axis, range -20 to 40°C)
- Plot energy rate curves including: total cooling rate and total heating rate from the fan coil unit (right axis, range 0 to 80000 kJ/h)
- Display all curves on a single graph with 7 gridpoints on the X-axis
